heading: Today
text: Early showers east ending. Some breaks of afternoon sun. A few local, passing showers.

heading: Thursday Night
text: Any evening showers ending. Periods of clouds north, becoming mostly clear south.

heading: Friday
text: Partly sunny.  A few afternoon showers north, likely across higher terrain.
temperature: Upper 60s to upper 70s, north to south

heading: Saturday
text: Clouds, some sun. Scattered showers, mainly from VT east.
